'''Waste incinerators''' were industrial buildings that dealt with the elimination of garbage. A number of them were located on the polluted [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Reuss VIII/Legends|Reuss VIII]].<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
